creator: Alexander Terp
description:
MIP-5 section 7, stage two of Codex as a full harness (stage one landed 2026-10-03: screen rules, the doorbell reading its prompt, hooks reporting state, extras/codex, ./dev --codex).
- Prompt at work (urgent rings into a working Codex, which steers) with its live check - measure the two-step ring (paste, look, Return) at Codex's approval prompt first.
- Messages fetched by Codex hooks: measure whether PostToolUse output reaches the model, and how Stop waits.
- Context used, from the rollout transcript's token_count, read from its tail only (bounded per hook).
- `codex queue --thread <id>` as a route that types nothing.
Open: whether an API error ends a Codex turn with Stop, Interrupt or nothing (a declared wait would stand until the next turn end); SubagentStart/Stop were not seen firing.
Know before relying on Codex in councils: a sandboxed Codex (workspace-write/read-only) cannot reach the daemon's Unix socket, so it cannot run muster msg read when rung unless sandbox_workspace_write.network_access = true (extras/codex/README.md).
title: 🧩 Codex stage two: urgent rings, messages by hooks, context, queue, resume
